# Knowledge-Core: Conventions

## `conventions.code-style`

Status: `verified`

Go constructors validate required dependencies and return (T, error); errors add operation context, preserve causes with %w, and use errors.Is/As. Context, deadlines, request IDs, and traces propagate end to end. Use pkg/codec/json for strict HTTP JSON and reuse shared auth, error, log, metadata, trace, and metrics contracts. Rust must pass rustfmt, clippy -D warnings, and cargo deny. Tests stay near implementations and cover success, boundaries, dependency failures, error mapping, cleanup/rollback, and concurrency with deterministic synchronization. Repository text uses LF except .bat and .cmd.

Sources: `user-confirmed`

## `security.secrets-and-config`

Status: `verified`

Secrets are injected only through environment variables or deployment-platform secret managers. Never place passwords, DSNs, JWTs, private keys, authorization/cookies, or API keys in YAML, source, snapshots, logs, metric labels, or span attributes. Logs use pkg/log and slog with context and stable low-cardinality fields; metrics use bounded route/RPC/status/code/dependency labels. External request IDs and W3C trace context follow shared middleware rules, and authentication, identity recheck, trusted-proxy, and rate-limit decisions fail closed on dependency errors.
